newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end up.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated widely before ending higher on Tuesday but dealers said most banks managed to square their positions.
They said rates were likely to rise on Wednesday amid an open market operation by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan.
"The overnight rates traded in a wide range of 12 percent to 18 percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
He said early deals were done at 12 to 14 percent but later in the day major trades were seen at 15 and 16 percent.
